# assessment rubric

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:assessmentRubric`](gmeow-assessmentRubric.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/assessmentRubric>

The rubric under which this assessment was made — version-pinning context for the score. Functional. Plays the [`observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md) role without the subproperty axiom ([`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) pattern).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on an [`Assessment`](../classes/gmeow-Assessment.md) to name the rubric under which it was made — version-pinning context for the score.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one rubric per assessment (it is functional) and avoid omitting both rubric and criterion (at least one is required — SHACL).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:assessmentRubric`](gmeow-assessmentRubric.md) once per assessment; it plays the [`observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md) role without the subproperty axiom, pinning the rubric version the score belongs to.
